name: production-factory-gates
_comment: ROLLOUT: evaluate -> observe -> active. enforcement=evaluate means nothing blocks yet; flip to active only after the 7 contexts are observed green (GITHUB_ENFORCEMENT_MAP.md section 6 rollout order). bypass_actors=[] means the owner obeys too: an admin can still merge AFTER checks pass, bypass only skips the waiting, so the default must stay [] or the ruleset is decoration. strict_required_status_checks_policy=true is the free re-gate loop: when main moves, required checks are invalidated and re-run against the new base, replacing the unbuilt regate.ts (mirrors src/guardrail.ts STALE-GATE).
